description: Team communication and messaging platform offering channels, direct messages, voice/video calls, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth2 and bearer tokens for API authentication and public/private apps.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Pumble account and access developer documentation and credentials self-serve.
api_notes: Covers workspaces, authentication, messages, and user interactions.
mcp_notes: Pumble provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to connect AI agents for chat summaries, file search, and automated updates.
rationale: Pumble provides fully documented APIs, self-serve free developer access, and an official MCP server enabling AI agent integration out of the box.
